question: What remedial ritual actions are required when pot installation was omitted during flag-raising?
premises: The prior context states pot installation may be omitted at flag-raising time.
A peace-fire-offering must be performed at the end.
The pot must be established according to the earlier procedure.
inference: If pot installation was omitted during flag-raising, one must perform a peace-fire-offering at the end and then establish the pot as before.
plain_english: Having performed a peace-fire-offering at the end, one should establish the pot as before.
